details: The cryptocurrency market experienced significant liquidations totaling $583 million in the past 24 hours. Data indicates that $511 million of this figure came from long positions, suggesting a period of market deleveraging and increased selling pressure.
title: Crypto Market Liquidations Hit $583 Million in 24 Hours

details: Bitcoin's price has decreased by 3.4% over the last 24 hours. This decline is largely attributed to significant institutional outflows, particularly from major players like BlackRock, contributing to substantial selling pressure. The market is also experiencing uncertainty ahead of upcoming Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) decisions, although long-term Bitcoin holders reportedly show increased conviction.
title: Bitcoin Price Drops 3.4% Amid Institutional Outflows and FOMC Concerns
